decisions.mark: concludes that the rule is ASYMMETRIC — the stated tiers REPLACE one another while the discovered layers ACCUMULATE and survive whatever anyone states
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "Tiers 3 and 4 accumulate, so a declared `entry_patterns` replaces only the built-in guesses and leaves Doxyfile-derived facts in place. A declaration can correct a guess but cannot remove a fact." | WHY: The answer says stated tiers (1, 2) replace one another while discovered tiers 3 and 4 accumulate and survive any stated tier. || QUOTE: "Tiers 3 and 4 accumulate, so a declared `entry_patterns` replaces only the built-in guesses and leaves Doxyfile-derived facts in place.
